start_here: Say to your AI: "Count my show's running jokes, crackers and storms, across the captions of every catalogued video." It runs tool:count-a-shows-running-jokes-in-its-captions with the terms in my settings row.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one settings row of yours (record:setting:measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging~<scope_kind>~<scope_id>) or the settings you pass, and works on files in the show's folder.
instructions: 1. Make the show's folder and the YouTube library folder the run may change, and have the catalog.tsv and the captions/<id>.en.json3 files, and the terms setting ({term: regular expression}) in your settings row. Put the keys the row needs (terms) in your settings row or pass them as settings.

2. Say the sentence in start_here to your AI. It calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:count-a-shows-running-jokes-in-its-captions and the input in the worked example; the door asks for the granted folder.
3. Read the last line it prints, {"result": ...}, or {"error": ...} saying what to fix (a missing settings key is named).
4. Read lore-terms.tsv: per term the mentions, videos, first and last date and a middle example; a rule the word judge cannot compile is refused with its reason.
